claims.content: The user creates a compressed archive by selecting objects, choosing compression format and storage space, setting the archive name, optionally splitting into volumes, appending timestamps, and applying encryption via password or keyfile.

goal.raw_text: The user creates a compressed archive by selecting objects, choosing compression format and storage space, setting the archive name, optionally splitting into volumes, appending timestamps, and applying encryption via password or keyfile.

claims.content: User
The File Manager Interface is active and displaying the computer's file system or archive contents.
The user has selected one or more objects (files or folders) to be archived, or is preparing to select them via the interface.
The system has available storage space on the target drive for the output archive.
The user initiates the archive creation process by selecting objects and accessing the Create Archive Interface, either through the File Manager Interface or via drag-and-drop.

trigger.raw_text: The user initiates the archive creation process by selecting objects and accessing the Create Archive Interface, either through the File Manager Interface or via drag-and-drop.

claims.content: The user accesses the Create Archive Interface, either directly via the 'Go to archiving layout' option in the Browser menu or by using the Drag and Drop feature.
In the Create archive window, the user selects the desired compression format from a list of supported formats for archiving and compression.
The user chooses the storage space (location on the computer system) where the archive is going to be saved.
The user sets the archive's name, defining what should happen in case of existence of a homonym file or archive in the selected storage space.
Optionally, the user configures the selected objects' data content to be split and compressed into more than one archive volume, defining the size of each.
Optionally, the user appends a timestamp to the created archive's name for archiving and backup purposes.
Optionally, the user applies encryption ('locking') to the created archives by setting a password and optionally a keyfile.
The system displays a graphic display of information and currently executed functions' progress window (PeaLauncher) showing the job status, input/output sizes, and time taken.
The system handles the case of existence of a homonym file or archive in the selected storage space by allowing the user to define what should happen.
The selected objects' data content is compressed into a single compressed archive, allowing handling and managing multiple objects as a single unit.
If the user opted to split the archive, the data content is divided into more than one archive volume with sizes defined by the user.
The created archive is saved in the chosen storage space on the computer system.
If encryption was applied, the created archive is 'locked' and requires a password and optionally a keyfile for decryption ('unlock').
A graphic display of information and currently executed functions' progress window (PeaLauncher) shows that the job was successfully completed.
